'''Venarian''' was a criminal. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was a servant to a major [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], but longed to control his own territory. To finance his future operation, Venarian began to siphon funds from his employer, and expanded into [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations.
